# Environmental Forest Products
> Professional forestry services in Sullivan, Orange & Ulster Counties, NY

## About
Environmental Forest Products, led by consulting forester Henry Kowalec, provides sustainable timber harvesting, land clearing, and woodland management services across the Hudson Valley and Catskills regions of New York. Serving private landowners, municipalities, and developers since 1991.

## Services
- Timber Harvesting & Sales
- Land Clearing (residential & commercial)
- 480-a Forest Tax Law Consulting
- Woodlot Management Plans
- Selective Cutting & Thinning
- Forestry Mulching
- Wildlife Habitat Management
- Tree Removal & Stump Grinding
- Tree Planting & Reforestation

## Service Area
Primary: Sullivan County, Orange County, Ulster County (NY)
Secondary: Pike County & Wayne County (PA), Sussex County (NJ)
